source: I want to make a copy of prison life

image_prompt.text: The prison yard as the oversized gathering space, sized for the whole server to mill around in without jamming
Guard towers and the main cell block roof, tall enough to navigate by from anywhere inside the walls
Detailed spots for roleplay scenes - the cafeteria, the visiting room, the yard fence line
Enterable cell blocks, cafeteria, guard station and administrative rooms
Rows of barred cells inside each cell block
A high perimeter security wall with fencing enclosing the whole complex

layout_placement.text: Separated start points for the guard team and the prisoner team
Weapon and equipment pickup points in the armoury on the guard side
Escape routes out of the complex that end the round for a prisoner who reaches them

notes: The entire prompt is the title of an existing Roblox game; the handoff is built from what that game's map is, not from anything the user described.
Roleplay's static settlement is standing in for a secured institution - it has no boundary wall, no opposed-role spawns and no escape exit, all of which this map needs.
Interiors are unavoidable here (cell blocks), so P3 applies.

open_questions.ask: Do you want the guard-versus-prisoner team loop with escapes and weapons, or just the prison map to roleplay in?
Should the map include the land outside the walls that escapees run to, or stop at the perimeter?

theme: Modern Urban - concrete, chain link, institutional

coverage_missing.ask: Guard-versus-prisoner team gameplay, or a static prison to roleplay in?
Does the map extend outside the walls?
How many players, and what is the guard-to-prisoner ratio?
Is escaping a win condition, or does the round just run continuously?

answers.ask: Do you want the guard-versus-prisoner team loop with escapes and weapons, or just the prison map to roleplay in?
answers.answer: Include the guard-versus-prisoner team loop with escapes and weapons, as in Prison Life.

answers.ask: Should the map include the land outside the walls that escapees run to, or stop at the perimeter?
answers.answer: Include a small outside area beyond the walls for escapees to run to.
